title: rubus macrophyllus subsp. lasiaxon
intro: Rubus macrophyllus subsp. lasiaxon, commonly known as the Chinese raspberry or Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the Himalayas and parts of China. The health benefits of Rubus macrophyllus subsp. lasiaxon include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against various diseases and promote overall health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relieve gastrointestinal issues, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Rubus macrophyllus subsp. lasiaxon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
